description: Search SvGrid docs, example demos and the API surface in ONE call. Start here for any "how do I ..." question - it covers all three, so you do not have to guess which one holds the answer. Call with no arguments for an index of doc sections, demo categories and API groups. Returns ids/slugs you can pass to svgrid_get.

category.description: Restrict demos to one category, exactly, e.g. "Kanban". Call with no arguments to see the categories.

detail.description: "concise" (default) returns titles plus a short excerpt. "full" returns the matching doc excerpts at length - more tokens, fewer follow-up calls.

limit.description: Max results per corpus. Default 10, max 50.

query.description: What you are trying to do, e.g. "pin a column", "server side pagination", "kanban swimlanes". Omit for the index.

section.description: Restrict docs to one section, exactly, e.g. "Help". Call with no arguments to see the sections.

name: svgrid_search
title: Search SvGrid
